purpose: Freeze the exact approval contract for the next no-submit Kaggle/Linux upstream rebuild parity run.

local_pre_approval_commands.why: Preferred one-command local readiness wrapper: focused approval contract checks, local runner smoke, freshness gate, and final prelaunch readiness. This remains local and no-network.
Run the focused local approval/guard contract lint, format-check, and pytest suite.
Refresh all no-submit local prelaunch reports after the focused contract suite passes.

exact_approval_required_commands.why: Push the small no-submit patch dataset with refreshed scripts, reports, submissions, and post-ID341 artifacts.
Verify Kaggle sees the large base dataset used for raw/processed competition files.
Verify Kaggle sees the patch dataset before pushing the runner.
Push the CPU-only upstream rebuild/parity runner notebook.
Poll until the runner is complete before pulling outputs.
Pull report-only outputs after the Kaggle runner completes.
Run local no-submit intake, remote summary, next-action decision, and the strict Public-0.58 artifact-review threshold gate on pulled outputs.

stop_rules: Do not execute any command above unless the user explicitly approves this exact command sequence.

Immediately before any Kaggle network command, prefer make kaggle-upstream-ready-local; at minimum run make kaggle-approval-contract-test and make kaggle-upstream-prelaunch-local locally, and stop if any local gate fails.
Every Kaggle network command must include ALLOW_KAGGLE_REMOTE=true; without it, Makefile targets fail closed.
Do not DACON-submit from Kaggle or local during this run.
Do not create a submission CSV, base_oof/base_test artifact, notebook history artifact, or submission_log row from pulled outputs automatically.
If the base or patch dataset file listings do not show the expected payloads, stop before pushing the runner.
If the runner fails or outputs are missing, stop and write a failure report instead of creating ID342.

Stop unless the Q3/S3 negative-map handoff is proven: the remote negative map is generated and staged, remaining-route inventory uses --negative-evidence-map, and eight closed local lanes are asserted.

Only after pulled reports pass safe intake, next-action, public/local gap, data/source coverage, no-forbidden-action, ID178-beating, and min_proxy <= 0.58 gates may a separate Public-0.58 artifact-contract review begin.
If pulled reports only beat ID178 but remain above 0.58, record an improvement lead only; do not create ID342.

decision.next_action: Ask for explicit approval of the exact command sequence before running Kaggle. Without approval, keep the repo in no-submit report-only mode.
